shorts.title: GTA 6 Tip: Bank Your Cash Before It's Gone
shorts.blurb: Cash in your pocket is lost when you die in GTA 6. I lost $531 on launch day. Bank it at an ATM.

parts.to: Whatever you carry is lost when you die.

parts.from: I had five hundred and thirty-one dollars on me on launch day.
So every time you pass an ATM with real money on you, stop and deposit it.
